question: Does Y030's bounded cached-assignment benefit transfer to freshly SHA256-keyed geometry when environment adds rapid alternating circular displacement, and at what extra matching cost?
hypothesis: Retained legal assignments can be less useful or harmful under alternating drift even in Y030's distinct keyed structured geometry family; preserve negative evidence.
freeze: Before first original invocation fix new seeds, immutable base generator, displacement schedule, all metrics and classification. No post-hoc geometry selection, retuning or retries.
base_geometry: Exact frozen Y030 source geometric generator; SHA256 keyed salt of 'Y030/'+decimal seed; four colliding homes plus preregistered asymmetric templates; seven active of sixteen motifs/cells and circular radius2.
intervention: Apply a common circular rotation displacement at each episode to every cell in existing neighbor sets, with cumulative displacement [0,1,6,7,12,13,18,19] (i.e., alternating +1 and +5). Spatial Hall cardinality remains invariant to a bijective global rotation within episode; compare changes through time.
arms: matched-cache-write sham: retains up to nine inactive observed assignments but does not read them
read-cache: identical writes and capacity; prefers previous observed assignment only if currently legal
temporal: Eight consecutive episodes per seed, deterministic active schedule inherited from Y030, no lookahead for a policy. Evaluator-only independent exhaustive 7-node Hall deficiency oracle and 8-episode SHA256 geometry signatures.
metrics: Full heldout per-seed and per-episode churn, matching cardinality, legal prior preference count, search calls, memory writes, occupancy parity and geometry signature uniqueness, no hidden model calls.
primary: ALL_SEED_BENEFIT if all heldout seeds have positive churn savings; MIXED if heldout signs differ or zeros coexist with positives; HARM if aggregate savings negative; NO_BENEFIT otherwise. GEOMETRY_DEFICIENCY if Hall<7 for any episode; NONUNIQUE_GEOMETRY if 8 cohort signatures collide.
validity: In evaluator preflight Hall check for every episode; if invalid, classify deficiency without feeding oracle to policy or silently changing capacity. Exact parent/source SHA, deterministic double evaluation, first-use original archive, one complete regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic heldout key variants and intervention only; unique hashes are not proof of full graph nonisomorphism or real-life developmental intelligence.
